content: Free static host limits (2026): all four majors (Cloudflare Pages, Netlify, Vercel, GitHub Pages) free; Cloudflare Pages only one with NO bandwidth cap + EU-friendly edge, 500 builds/mo; Netlify/Vercel cap ~100GB/mo with overage fees (.15/GB), Netlify added credit-based billing Sept 2025 and pauses sites over free-tier limits; GitHub Pages free only serves PUBLIC repos (private requires paid), soft 100GB/mo, 1GB repo, 10 builds/hr soft limit (bypassable with Actions), US data centers; all support custom domains + free auto-renewing SSL; free subdomains (pages.dev, netlify.app, github.io) are real URLs. For a tiny personal site, bandwidth/builds are non-issues; the real gotchas are: public-repo requirement (privacy of a child-focused repo), message 'paused due to overage', and US data transit for a German audience.
